fusions.name: Levelling Stroke
fusions.desc: A crushing overhead blow that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 30% easier to wound for 8 seconds. It also deals 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Flatten Ranks
fusions.desc: Slams the flat of the axe down, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Dead Weight
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Wedge
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 15% more damage.
